newsitem.title: UK: Molins finds accounting error at U.S. unit.
newsitem.headline: Molins finds accounting error at U.S. unit.

text.p: Specialist engineering group Molins Plc said on Wednesday that it has identified accounting irregularities at its U.S. subsidiary Langston Corp which have resulted in an overstatement of group profits.
Molins said in a statement that it has instructed an immediate investigation into the precise nature of the irregularities and on their financial effect.
It said that preliminary indications suggest that the overstatement of pretax profits could be around $12 million after taking account of anticipated tax relief.
The firm reported profit after tax of 24.9 million stg for 1996 with operating profit at the U.S. unit of 3.7 million stg.
It added that any adjustments would likely be treated as an exceptional item in its 1997 accounts.
The president and chief financial officer of Langston has been dismissed and replaced by a general manager and finance director from the UK.
